data.title: Former Meetings
data.lede: A concise archive of International Hantavirus Conference milestones.

data.heading: Triennial exchange across hantavirus research communities.
paragraphs: The International Society for Hantaviruses was founded in 1989 with its first meeting in Seoul, Korea. This archive now includes photo and abstract-book material recovered from the Webpage asset package.

data.heading: Two lectureship awards frame the scientific legacy of each triennial ICH.
paragraphs: At each triennial ICH, the Ho-Wang Lee Lifetime Achievement Award recognizes a senior hantavirologist for exceptional contributions to hantavirus research, while the Joel M. Dalrymple Memorial Award honors an early- to mid-career researcher whose innovative and forward-looking work reflects the legacy of Dr. Dalrymple at the U.S. Army Medical Research Institute of Infectious Diseases.
